title: Sitrep 6: Device Network Isolation — Monitoring Reconnection Decision

fields.incidentName: Ghost Pumps — Infusion Pump Integrity and Clinical Trust
fields.summary: Device network 10.40.x.x has been isolated since 16:15. Twenty-eight of 41 affected infusion pumps have been re-flashed from the offline 4.2.1 copy and verified via test infusions; 13 remain. Loaner pumps are en route and expected at 20:00. Central telemetry for 32 ICU beds remains dark. One-to-one observation continues for 12 high-risk patients. ORRMC-PUMP01 has been isolated and imaged. The ISO proposes reconnecting only the monitoring network behind a new firewall rule that permits ORRMC-MON01 to communicate with bedside monitors only, after the telemetry server is rebuilt. Rebuild time estimated at 3 hours. Decision required on the night plan.

actions.text: Device network 10.40.x.x isolated via firewall rule HCC-OPS-1043
Clinical Engineering re-flashed 22 pumps from offline 4.2.1 copy; verification complete
Forensic imaging of ORRMC-PUMP01 completed and stored on ORRMC-BKP01
ISO issued request to rebuild ORRMC-MON01 under new network policy (HCC-OPS-1043b)

planned: ISO to complete telemetry server rebuild by 21:00
Reconnect monitoring network only to bedside monitors via new firewall rule (HCC-OPS-1043b)
Maintain one-to-one observation for 12 high-risk patients until monitoring restored
Next sitrep at 22:00 or on significant change
issues: Central telemetry remains dark; no remote monitoring for 32 ICU patients
12 high-risk patients under one-to-one observation; staffing shortage persists
No alternative to one-to-one observation; portable monitors not available
fields.preparedBy: S. Patel, Planning Section Chief (Situation Unit)

instructorNote: This is a decision-point inject. The AOC must decide whether to reconnect monitoring only, after the telemetry server is rebuilt and the ISO signs off. The network remains isolated overnight. No system is declared safe yet.
